mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that may lead to reduced corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0, the 5-day forward return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) falls below 1700, it signals a simultaneous contraction in supply and demand, leading to a recessionary fear that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 1700, the 20-day forward return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to heightened recession risks and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 3.0, the 60-day forward return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated unemployment signals weak consumer demand and potential corporate earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for UNRATE against 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in the industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100, the 5-day forward return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1700 thousand units and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below 650000 million dollars, it signals a deepening housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1700 AND RSAFS < 650000, the 20-day forward return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer demand regime (RSAFS > 700000 million dollars), the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to strong consumer spending and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where RSAFS > 700000, the 60-day forward return is negative.
